Кремний.about: Silicon for bones: the only umbrella review - effect on bone metabolism mainly in animals; The threshold of effect achievable in humans has not been determined.
Кремний.caution: There is little data on the safety of supplements; excess microelements are not indicated; In the review, many regimens exceed the norm of 25 mg/day.
Кремний.food_sources: Whole grains, vegetables, root vegetables, bananas, drinking water; Product specifics are not provided in the abstracts.
Кремний.guidelines: Umbrella review 2024 (Nutrients): effect threshold ~139 mg Si/kg/day - unrealistic for humans; Recommendations for supplements are not formulated.
Кремний.how_to_choose: There is no data for choosing a form; if you are interested in silicon, use food sources instead of dietary supplements; The effectiveness of supplements has not been confirmed.
mechs: The effect of silicon on bone and mineral metabolism
in animal studies positive effect at high doses
Translation of results from animals to humans
threshold ~139 mg/kg/day is unlikely to be achievable in humans
Кремний.myths: “Silicon strengthens everyone’s bones” – 2024 survey data mainly from animals. “Effective dose achievable”—the threshold of ~139 mg/kg/day is unrealistic for humans. “The only review is proven” - people have little data.
Кремний.name: Silicon
Кремний.onset: Not established: The review did not determine the effective dose and timing of effect in humans.
Кремний.title: Silicon
Кремний.upper_limit: not established (not given in abstracts; the norm of 25 mg/day is mentioned in the review)
Кремний.who_needs: Indications are not defined: there is little data on the benefits of dietary supplements in humans; animal review reveals potential role in bone metabolism; For healthy people without deficiency, supplementation is not justified.
